image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a textured, grey rocky surface. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular bright yellow patches and spots. Its skin appears wet and smooth. The head is visible on the left, showing a small dark eye. The forelimbs are splayed, revealing black digits. The tail extends to the right, tapering off. There is a small, blurry brown object (possibly a worm or debris) in the upper right background.
